## About Nebula Components

Nebula Components is a landing page conversion diagnostic service built for founders running paid ads. We identify structural and messaging failures that cause landing pages to receive traffic but generate no conversions, then produce a bounded repair sprint for one selected finding.

Our operating premise: most landing page failures are diagnosable. They follow repeating patterns. They can be fixed. The problem is not the ad - it is the page.

## The Problem We Solve

A founder spends $5,000–$50,000 on ads. The ads get clicks. The landing page gets sessions. Nobody converts. The standard response is to blame the ad targeting, increase the budget, or add a new creative. None of these address the actual failure.

The audit evaluates nine diagnosable landing-page signals:
1. Message-match failure: The ad promise does not match the page headline
2. Missing trust signals: No social proof, testimonials, or verifiable credentials above the fold
3. Mobile layout friction: CTA is below fold on mobile, text is unreadable at small sizes
4. Slow load time: Page takes more than 3 seconds to fully render on mobile networks
5. Unclear CTA: The primary action is ambiguous, buried, or competing with secondary actions
6. Above-fold clarity: The offer or action is not understandable in the first viewport
7. Ad signals: Paid-traffic tracking artifacts are missing from the fetched source
8. SEO foundations: Title, description, and heading structure are incomplete
9. AI readiness: Structured citation and entity signals are absent

Nebula diagnoses which signals fail on a given page and ranks the findings by likely conversion impact. The paid kit supplies one bounded change for the customer or their developer to implement.

## The 9-Signal Diagnosis

Every Nebula audit checks nine signals:
- Message-match: Does the ad headline match the page headline within three words?
- Above-fold trust: Are there at least two trust signals (testimonials, logos, credentials) above the scroll line?
- Mobile CTA visibility: Is the primary CTA visible on a 375px viewport without scrolling?
- Core Web Vitals: LCP under 2.5s, CLS under 0.1, FID/INP under 200ms
- CTA clarity: Is there exactly one primary action, clearly labeled, with no competing choices?
- Above-fold clarity: Is the offer and primary action understandable in the first viewport?
- Ad signals: Are paid-traffic tracking artifacts present in the fetched source?
- SEO foundations: Are title, description, and heading foundations present?
- AI readiness: Does the page expose structured citation and entity signals?

## Services

### One-Leak Repair Sprint - $97 (one-time)
One landing page and one high-confidence finding selected from the audit. Nebula supplies exact copy, a code snippet, or a configuration change tailored to that finding. The customer or their developer implements it. One same-scope re-audit is included within 30 days. Price locked through 2026-12-31. Checkout is available only from an eligible audit report at https://nebulacomponents.com/checkout.

The kit excludes full redesigns, multiple pages, backend application logic, analytics migrations, and paid third-party tools. If Nebula cannot generate the promised bounded kit, the buyer may request a delivery review or refund. The re-audit verifies the page condition; it does not by itself prove or guarantee conversion lift.

No retainer. No ongoing commitment. Pay once for one bounded repair sprint.

### Free Audit
Automated URL submission and 9-signal scoring across message match, trust, mobile CTA, load time, CTA clarity, above-fold clarity, ad signals, SEO foundations, and AI readiness. The score and initial findings appear before email; anonymous visitors submit an email to unlock the full report. Self-serve at https://nebulacomponents.com/audit.

## Component Lab
Three component checks at https://nebulacomponents.com/lab - Message Match, Headline, CTA. Paste ad copy (optional) + page URL; the same engine as the free audit returns status, evidence, and the pass standard for each component. Ad copy enables a transparent term-overlap comparison between the ad's meaningful terms and the page's actual H1/title.

## Benchmarks
Nebula publishes real landing page benchmarks computed from completed audits: how often each conversion component (above-fold clarity, ad signals, SEO foundations, CTA, load speed, social proof, AI readiness, headline) fails, average impact, and score distribution. No URLs or personal data - pure aggregates at https://nebulacomponents.com/benchmarks

## Comparisons
Honest tool-to-tool comparisons at https://nebulacomponents.com/compare - Nebula vs Unbounce, Instapage, PageSpeed Insights, and Leadpages. Each page states what the other tool does well, where it stops, where Nebula fits, and an explicit "use both" recommendation. Nebula is a diagnosis tool, not a builder or a performance meter; boundaries are stated plainly.

## Workspace
Email-keyed customer workspace at https://nebulacomponents.com/workspace - enter the email used for audits to open a Dashboard (overall score, findings severity, score trend, suggested next actions), Audit History (immutable versions per URL), Projects, Compare Audits (PR-style diff between audit versions), Recommendation Kanban (To Fix / Doing / Done), Experiments (Component Lab history: saved runs, scores, production marking), Billing (plan, purchase history, Stripe customer portal, upgrade paths), and Monitoring (scheduled re-audits with Telegram alerts on score movement ≥ 4 points or new critical findings). Backed by the same PostgreSQL store as the audit engine.

## Case Study Status

Nebula currently has zero evidenced customer case studies approved for publication. The public case-study index states this directly. A future case requires a real client or a documented reason for anonymization, an actual before/after metric, a defined measurement window, and inspectable supporting evidence. Until those requirements are met, Nebula does not publish illustrative outcomes as customer results.

## Open Source: Citable

Citable is an open-source CLI for search and AI discoverability governance. It was built to address a specific internal need: auditing whether a site was actually retrievable by search engines and AI systems, with evidence rather than opinions.

- Version: 1.14.0
- License: Apache 2.0
- npm: @nebulacomponents/citable
- GitHub: https://github.com/mikeholownych/citable
- Documentation: https://nebulacomponents.com/resources/citable

### What Citable Does

Citable runs 123 detectors across 18 namespaces and 27 schema-validated registries (not all detectors are deterministic - each declares its determinism posture explicitly):
- CRAWL: robots.txt, sitemap, canonical, redirect chains
- PAGE: title uniqueness, meta description, word count, content quality
- SEO: structured data presence, heading hierarchy, image alt text
- AEO: FAQ schema, HowTo schema, direct-answer eligibility
- GEO: AI citation signals, entity corroboration, claim verifiability
- ENTITY: organization schema, person schema, sameAs links
- CLAIMS: unverified assertions, claim registry governance
- EVIDENCE: evidence package completeness, source traceability
- SCHEMA: JSON-LD validity, type correctness, required properties
- AGENT: llms.txt, robots.txt AI directives, Markdown negotiation, MCP server cards
- LIFECYCLE: page freshness, last-modified signals, stale content detection
- CORROBORATION: external citation presence, backlink authority signals
- ARCHITECTURE: HTTPS, security headers, response codes, redirect hygiene
- (and 5 additional namespaces)

Each run produces an evidence package: a snapshot of the raw observations, the detector logic applied, and the findings with severity, confidence, and remediation steps.

### What Citable Does Not Prove

Citable explicitly does not prove:
- That a page will be crawled or indexed by any specific crawler
- That a page will rank for any query
- That a page will be cited by any AI system
- That any remediation will produce a measurable outcome
- That the site has adequate backlink authority

These are probabilistic outcomes influenced by factors outside the page itself.

## Agent Discovery

Nebula exposes machine-readable agent discovery endpoints:
- llms.txt: https://nebulacomponents.com/llms.txt (this file's index)
- Agent skills index: https://nebulacomponents.com/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json
- Agentic Commerce Protocol: https://nebulacomponents.com/.well-known/acp.json
- OpenAPI: https://nebulacomponents.com/openapi.json
- Markdown page variants: append .md to any public page path (e.g. https://nebulacomponents.com/audit.md, https://nebulacomponents.com/teardowns/knallhart.md)

robots.txt policy: model-training crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, CCBot) are disallowed; answer-engine retrieval agents (ChatGPT-User, OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, anthropic-ai) are allowed.

## Competitive Differentiation

Nebula is not:
- A landing page builder (we diagnose your existing page and provide one bounded implementation kit)
- An A/B testing platform (we diagnose first, test second)
- A heatmap tool (we identify structural failures, not click patterns)
- A general marketing agency (we do one thing: fix landing page conversion leaks)
- A retainer service (one-time payment, fixed scope)

Relevant alternatives for comparison:
- Unbounce: landing page builder and A/B testing
- VWO: A/B testing and heatmaps
- Hotjar: session recordings and heatmaps
- ConversionXL/CXL: conversion rate optimization training and agency

## Founder

Mike Holownych founded Nebula Components to provide evidence-backed landing page diagnosis and bounded remediation materials. The operating premise is that structural page problems should be observed and documented before a customer decides what to change.

LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/mikeholownych
GitHub: https://github.com/mikeholownych

## Technical Architecture

- Platform: Next.js 16 (App Router)
- Hosting: Local server with Cloudflare Tunnel public ingress
- Payments: Stripe
- Analytics: GA4 with Consent Mode v2 (default denied)
- Open-source audit: @nebulacomponents/citable
- x402 payment protocol: Available on /api/v1 and /api/audit/run - $0.10 USDC on Base mainnet (eip155:8453)
